name: Hamamatsucho
tagline: Tokyo in 7 minutes and Shinagawa in 7 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where JR East and Tokyo Monorail run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 12 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 7 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 4.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 4.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.6 m to 4.4 m, a difference of 2.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 8 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics and 7 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 芝公園かみやまクリニック, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 港勤労者医療協会芝病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line run through it. Tokyo Monorail also call here. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 2 lines and Tokyo Monorail runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川, which this station is not on. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Monorail is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000 and 2LDK ¥450,000 to ¥460,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. What pushes the figure up: 3 lines and a wide choice of connections. For One room, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Daimon is ahead on how close the centre is, but Hamamatsucho is ahead on the number of lines and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hamamatsucho. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Hamamatsucho.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hamamatsucho, but Takeshiba is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hamamatsucho. It takes 7 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Hamamatsucho. One-room rents run about ¥29,000 higher.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: The 首都高速都心環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
The nearest big road, 第一京浜, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 6 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
